title: RF reflected power high during etch
notes: Repeat alarm: if the same tool reported the same alarm code in the last 7 days, do the steps below and also notify the equipment engineer to escalate.

steps.text: Check the RF matching network for a tuning fault.
Check the RF cable connections.
Check that the chamber pressure is within spec.
If all of the above are normal, stop the tool and notify maintenance.

title: Process gas flow out of range during etch
notes: Repeat alarm: if the same tool reported the same alarm code in the last 7 days, do the steps below and also notify the equipment engineer to escalate.

If all of the above are normal, stop the tool and notify maintenance.

Check the chamber lid O-ring for damage.

If the leak rate is still high, keep the tool down and notify maintenance.
